jobs.title: Market Risk Manager – Oil products

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des risques du marché – Produits pétroliers

jobs.description:
Main purpose

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Market Risk Manager for Oil Products. The ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of relevant experience as a trader or risk manager specializing in the trading of physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house. This role requires an in-depth understanding of physical oil markets, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality and blending, regulations, market dynamics, contractual terms, and market participants. The successful candidate will be responsible for aggregating Trafigura's exposure, identifying concentrated risks, and reporting these to the Head of Market Risk. Additionally, the role involves collaborating with front office teams, senior management, and contributing to the development of risk management systems.

This role will report to Head of Market Risk Physical Oil Products and will sit with the broader Market Risk team in Geneva to facilitate interaction with global trading desks and IT teams which support the Market Risk Management organization.

Key responsibilities

• Risk Aggregation & Reporting:

• Aggregate and analyze Trafigura’s exposure across physical oil products in a meaningful way.

• Identify and highlight categories of concentrated risk, reporting findings to the Head of Market Risk.

• Set up risk limits and monitor their usage, ensuring alignment with Trafigura’s risk appetite.

• Market Risk Analysis:

• Design and implement risk scenarios including historical analysis, ad hoc scenarios, and stress tests.

• Ensure accuracy in Value at Risk (VaR) calculations and provide detailed P&L breakdowns and explanations.

• Perform continuous monitoring and assessment of market dynamics, pricing mechanisms, and trading strategies.

• Collaboration & Communication:

• Maintain strong interactions with the front office, providing risk insights and ensuring alignment on risk management strategies.

• Liaise with senior management to communicate risk positions, potential exposures, and strategic recommendations.

• Work closely with the IT and systems teams to enhance risk management tools, ensuring they meet the evolving needs of the market.

• Risk Management Systems Development:

• Contribute to the development and refinement of risk management systems, ensuring robust data integration and analytical capabilities.

• Utilize SQL, Python, and AI to navigate and enhance the existing risk management landscape.

• Ensure systems are capable of providing accurate, real-time data for decision-making and reporting purposes.

• Regulatory Compliance & Risk Governance:

• Stay informed on global regulations affecting the oil market, including environmental policies, sanctions, and trade restrictions.

• Ensure compliance with all relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies. Lead all aspects of the establishment and maintenance of strong contractual risk management processes.

Required qualifications

• Minimum of 10 years of experience as a trader or risk manager in physical oil products at a reputable physical commodities trading house.

• Deep knowledge of physical oil markets, including types of oil products, pricing mechanisms, logistics, quality, blending, and market dynamics.

• Strong understanding of contractual terms, credit risk, and the upstream and downstream oil market participants.

• Proven experience in aggregating exposure, managing concentrated risks, and reporting to senior management.

• Proficiency in SQL and Python, and other relevant tools for risk management and system development.

• Good knowledge of financial derivatives is a must-have.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front office teams and senior management.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to design and implement complex risk scenarios and stress tests.

• Highly motivated with a collaborative mindset and a keen appetite for system enhancement and risk management innovation.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in developing and enhancing risk management systems in a trading environment.

• Familiarity with Trafigura’s business model and risk management approach.

Attributes for success

• Ability to transverse risk data landscape and translate into actionable risk management in practice

• Comfortable working across a wide array of items while also able to focus on specific topics as needed

• Effective at building consensus around change initiatives to propel business forward

Department overview

The Market Risk Management team within Trafigura is responsible for not only the identification and quantification of market risks across oil products, power & gas and metals but also the effective risk management of those exposures – this role’s specific focus will be on the physical oil products line.

Equal opportunity employer

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse workforce! We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, disability, or any other legally protected status.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto principale

Stiamo cercando un esperto e altamente qualificato Market Risk Manager per i prodotti petroliferi. Il candidato ideale avrà almeno 10 anni di esperienza rilevante come trader o responsabile del rischio specializzato nella negoziazione di prodotti petroliferi fisici in una casa di trading di merci fisiche rispettabile. Questo ruolo richiede una comprensione approfondita dei mercati del petrolio fisico, dei meccanismi di prezzi, della logistica, della qualità e della miscelazione, delle normative, delle dinamiche di mercato, dei termini contrattuali e dei partecipanti al mercato. Il candidato di successo sarà responsabile dell'aggregazione dell'esposizione di Trafigura, dell'identificazione dei rischi concentrati e della segnalazione al responsabile del rischio di mercato. Inoltre, il ruolo consiste nel collaborare con team di front office, senior management e contribuire allo sviluppo di sistemi di gestione del rischio.

Questo ruolo si riferirà a Head of Market Risk Physical Oil Products e si sederà con il più ampio team di Market Risk a Ginevra per facilitare l'interazione con i banchi di trading globali e i team IT che supportano l'organizzazione Market Risk Management.

Responsabilità chiave

• Aggregazione di rischio & Reporting:

• Aggregare e analizzare l'esposizione di Trafigura attraverso i prodotti dell'olio fisico in modo significativo.

• Identificare e evidenziare le categorie di rischio concentrato, segnalando i risultati al Capo del Rischio di Mercato.

• Impostare i limiti di rischio e monitorare il loro utilizzo, garantendo l’allineamento con l’appetito di rischio di Trafigura.

• Analisi del rischio di mercato:

• Progettare e implementare scenari di rischio tra cui analisi storiche, scenari ad hoc e test di stress.

• Assicurare l'accuratezza nei calcoli di Valore in Risk (VaR) e fornire dettagliate guasti e spiegazioni P&L.

• Eseguire il monitoraggio continuo e la valutazione delle dinamiche di mercato, dei meccanismi di prezzi e delle strategie di trading.

• Collaborazione e comunicazione:

• Mantenere forti interazioni con l'ufficio frontale, fornendo informazioni sui rischi e garantendo l'allineamento sulle strategie di gestione dei rischi.

• Liaise con senior management per comunicare posizioni di rischio, potenziali esposizioni e raccomandazioni strategiche.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team IT e sistemi per migliorare gli strumenti di gestione del rischio, assicurando loro di soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione del mercato.

• Sviluppo dei sistemi di gestione del rischio:

• Contribuisci allo sviluppo e alla raffinatezza dei sistemi di gestione dei rischi, garantendo una solida integrazione dei dati e capacità analitiche.

• Utilizzare SQL, Python e AI per navigare e migliorare il paesaggio di gestione del rischio esistente.

• Assicurare che i sistemi siano in grado di fornire dati precisi e in tempo reale per scopi decisionali e di reporting.

• Compliance & Risk Governance:

• Restate informati sulle normative globali che riguardano il mercato petrolifero, comprese le politiche ambientali, le sanzioni e le restrizioni commerciali.

• Assicurare la conformità a tutti i requisiti normativi e politiche interne pertinenti. Condurre tutti gli aspetti della creazione e della manutenzione di forti processi di gestione dei rischi contrattuali.

qualifiche richieste

• Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza come commerciante o responsabile del rischio nei prodotti del petrolio fisico in una casa di trading di merci fisiche rispettabile.

• Conoscenza profonda dei mercati del petrolio fisico, compresi i tipi di prodotti petroliferi, meccanismi di prezzi, logistica, qualità, miscelazione e dinamica del mercato.

• Forte comprensione dei termini contrattuali, del rischio di credito e dei partecipanti al mercato petrolifero a monte e a valle.

• Esperienza comprovata nell'aggregazione dell'esposizione, nella gestione dei rischi concentrati e nel reporting alla gestione senior.

• Proficienza in SQL e Python, e altri strumenti rilevanti per la gestione del rischio e lo sviluppo del sistema.

• La buona conoscenza dei derivati finanziari è un must-have.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di interagire efficacemente con i team di front office e senior management.

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di progettare e implementare scenari di rischio complessi e test di stress.

• Altamente motivato con una mentalità collaborativa e un forte appetito per il miglioramento del sistema e l'innovazione di gestione del rischio.

Le qualifiche previste

• Esperienza nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento dei sistemi di gestione dei rischi in un ambiente di trading.

• Familiarità con il modello aziendale di Trafigura e l’approccio alla gestione dei rischi.

Attributi per il successo

• Capacità di trasversare il paesaggio dei dati di rischio e tradurre in gestione del rischio attuabile in pratica

• Confortevole lavoro su una vasta gamma di elementi, anche in grado di concentrarsi su argomenti specifici come necessario

• Efficace nella costruzione del consenso circa le iniziative di cambiamento per spingere avanti il business

Panoramica del Dipartimento

Il team Market Risk Management all’interno di Trafigura è responsabile non solo dell’identificazione e della quantificazione dei rischi di mercato nei prodotti petroliferi, nel gas e nei metalli, ma anche dell’efficace gestione dei rischi di tali esposizioni – il focus specifico di questo ruolo sarà sulla linea dei prodotti petroliferi fisici.

Datore di lavoro pari opportunità

Siamo un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità e siamo orgogliosi di una forza lavoro diversificata! Non discriviamo in assunzioni, assunzioni, formazione, promozione o altre pratiche di lavoro per motivi di razza, colore, religione, genere, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, età, stato civile o veterano, condizione medica o handicap, disabilità, o qualsiasi altro stato legalmente protetto.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Hauptzweck

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und hochqualifizierten Market Risk Manager für Ölprodukte. Der ideale Kandidat verfügt über mindestens 10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung als Händler oder Risikomanager, der sich auf den Handel mit physischen Ölprodukten bei einem seriösen Handelshaus für physische Rohstoffe spezialisiert hat. Diese Rolle erfordert ein gründliches Verständnis der physischen Ölmärkte, Preismechanismen, Logistik, Qualität und Mischung, Vorschriften, Marktdynamik, Vertragsbedingungen und Marktteilnehmer. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird dafür verantwortlich sein, das Engagement von Trafigura zu aggregieren, konzentrierte Risiken zu identifizieren und diese dem Head of Market Risk zu melden. Darüber hinaus umfasst die Rolle die Zusammenarbeit mit Front-Office-Teams, der Geschäftsleitung und einen Beitrag zur Entwicklung von Risikomanagementsystemen.

Diese Rolle wird an den Head of Market Risk Physical Oil Products berichten und dem breiteren Market Risk Team in Genf angehören, um die Interaktion mit globalen Handelsschaltern und IT-Teams zu erleichtern, die die Organisation des Market Risk Management unterstützen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Risikoaggregation & Reporting:

• Aggregieren und analysieren Sie Trafiguras Exposition gegenüber physischen Ölprodukten auf sinnvolle Weise.

• Ermittlung und Hervorhebung von Kategorien konzentrierter Risiken, Berichterstattung über die Ergebnisse an den Leiter des Marktrisikos.

• Legen Sie Risikolimits fest und überwachen Sie deren Verwendung, um die Übereinstimmung mit der Risikobereitschaft von Trafigura sicherzustellen.

• Marktrisikoanalyse:

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie Risikoszenarien, einschließlich historischer Analysen, Ad-hoc-Szenarien und Stresstests.

• Stellen Sie die Genauigkeit der Value at Risk (VaR) -Berechnungen sicher und liefern Sie detaillierte P & L-Aufgliederungen und Erklärungen.

• Führen Sie eine kontinuierliche Überwachung und Bewertung der Marktdynamik, Preismechanismen und Handelsstrategien durch.

• Zusammenarbeit & Kommunikation:

• Pflegen Sie starke Interaktionen mit dem Front Office, bieten Sie Informationen zu Risiken und gewährleisten Sie die Ausrichtung auf Risikomanagementstrategien.

• Verbindung mit der Geschäftsleitung, um Risikopositionen, potenzielle Expositionen und strategische Empfehlungen zu kommunizieren.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit den IT- und Systemteams zusammen, um die Risikomanagement-Tools zu verbessern und sicherzustellen, dass sie den sich ändernden Anforderungen des Marktes entsprechen.

• Entwicklung von Risikomanagementsystemen:

• Beitrag zur Entwicklung und Verfeinerung von Risikomanagement-Systemen, um eine robuste Datenintegration und Analysefähigkeiten zu gewährleisten.

• Verwenden Sie SQL, Python und AI, um die bestehende Risikomanagement-Landschaft zu navigieren und zu verbessern.

• Sicherstellen, dass Systeme in der Lage sind, genaue Echtzeitdaten für Entscheidungs- und Berichtszwecke bereitzustellen.

• Regulatory Compliance & Risk Governance:

• Bleiben Sie informiert über globale Vorschriften, die den Ölmarkt beeinflussen, einschließlich Umweltpolitik, Sanktionen und Handelsbeschränkungen.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung aller relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen und internen Richtlinien. Führen Sie alle Aspekte der Einrichtung und Aufrechterhaltung starker vertraglicher Risikomanagementprozesse.

Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung als Händler oder Risikomanager in physischen Ölprodukten bei einem seriösen physischen Rohstoffhandelshaus.

• Tiefe Kenntnisse der physischen Ölmärkte, einschließlich Arten von Ölprodukten, Preismechanismen, Logistik, Qualität, Mischung und Marktdynamik.

• Starkes Verständnis der Vertragsbedingungen, des Kreditrisikos und der vor- und nachgelagerten Ölmarktteilnehmer.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Aggregation von Exposures, dem Management konzentrierter Risiken und der Berichterstattung an die Geschäftsleitung.

• Kenntnisse in SQL und Python und anderen relevanten Tools für Risikomanagement und Systementwicklung.

• Gute Kenntnisse über Finanzderivate sind ein Muss.

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Front-Office-Teams und der Geschäftsleitung zu interagieren.

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Risikoszenarien und Stresstests zu entwerfen und umzusetzen.

• Hoch motiviert mit einer kollaborativen Denkweise und einem starken Appetit auf Systemverbesserung und Risikomanagement-Innovation.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von Risikomanagement-Systemen in einem Handelsumfeld.

• Vertrautheit mit Trafiguras Geschäftsmodell und Risikomanagementansatz.

Attribute für den Erfolg

• Fähigkeit, die Risikodatenlandschaft zu transzendieren und in der Praxis in ein umsetzbares Risikomanagement umzusetzen

• Komfortables Arbeiten in einer Vielzahl von Elementen und gleichzeitig in der Lage, sich bei Bedarf auf bestimmte Themen zu konzentrieren

• Effektiv beim Aufbau eines Konsenses über Veränderungsinitiativen, um das Geschäft voranzutreiben

Abteilungsübersicht

Das Marktrisikomanagement-Team von Trafigura ist nicht nur für die Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Marktrisiken für Ölprodukte, Strom & Gas und Metalle verantwortlich, sondern auch für das effektive Risikomanagement dieser Risiken - der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle wird auf der physischen Ölproduktlinie liegen.

Wir sind ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber und sind stolz auf eine vielfältige Belegschaft! Wir diskriminieren nicht bei der Rekrutierung, Einstellung, Ausbildung, Beförderung oder anderen Beschäftigungspraktiken aus Gründen der Rasse, der Hautfarbe, der Religion, des Geschlechts, der sexuellen Orientierung, der nationalen Herkunft, des Alters, des Familien- oder Veteranenstatus, des Gesundheitszustands oder einer Behinderung, einer Behinderung oder eines anderen gesetzlich geschützten Status.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Objet principal

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire du risque commercial expérimenté et hautement qualifié pour les produits pétroliers. Le candidat idéal aura au moins 10 ans d'expérience pertinente en tant que trader ou gestionnaire de risques se spécialisant dans le commerce de produits pétroliers physiques dans une maison de commerce de marchandises physiques de bonne réputation. Ce rôle exige une compréhension approfondie des marchés du pétrole, des mécanismes de tarification, de la logistique, de la qualité et du mélange, de la réglementation, de la dynamique du marché, des conditions contractuelles et des participants au marché. Le candidat retenu sera chargé d'agréger l'exposition de Trafigura, d'identifier les risques concentrés et de les signaler au responsable du risque de marché. De plus, le rôle consiste à collaborer avec les équipes de direction, la haute direction et à contribuer à l'élaboration de systèmes de gestion des risques.

Ce rôle relèvera du chef des produits pétroliers physiques à risque de marché et siégera avec l'équipe du risque de marché à Genève afin de faciliter l'interaction avec les comptoirs commerciaux mondiaux et les équipes informatiques qui appuient l'organisation de gestion des risques de marché.

Principales responsabilités

• Agrégation et déclaration des risques :

• Agrégez et analysez l'exposition de Trafigura à travers les produits pétroliers physiques de manière significative.

• Identifier et mettre en évidence les catégories de risque concentré, en rendant compte des constatations au responsable du risque de marché.

• Mettre en place des limites de risque et surveiller leur utilisation, en assurant l'alignement avec Trafigura.

• Analyse des risques du marché :

• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des scénarios de risque comprenant une analyse historique, des scénarios ad hoc et des tests de résistance.

• Assurer l'exactitude des calculs de la valeur à risque (VaR) et fournir des ventilations et des explications détaillées sur la valeur à risque.

• Suivre et évaluer en permanence la dynamique du marché, les mécanismes de tarification et les stratégies commerciales.

• Collaboration et communication :

• Maintenir de solides interactions avec le bureau principal, fournir des renseignements sur les risques et assurer l'harmonisation des stratégies de gestion des risques.

• Assurer la liaison avec la haute direction pour communiquer les positions de risque, les expositions potentielles et les recommandations stratégiques.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes TI et systèmes pour améliorer les outils de gestion des risques, en s'assurant qu'ils répondent aux besoins changeants du marché.

• Développement de systèmes de gestion des risques :

• Contribuer à l'élaboration et au perfectionnement des systèmes de gestion des risques, en assurant une solide intégration des données et des capacités d'analyse.

• Utilisez SQL, Python et AI pour naviguer et améliorer le paysage de gestion des risques existant.

• Veiller à ce que les systèmes soient en mesure de fournir des données exactes et en temps réel aux fins de la prise de décisions et de l'établissement de rapports.

• Conformité réglementaire et gouvernance des risques :

• Restez informé sur les réglementations mondiales affectant le marché pétrolier, y compris les politiques environnementales, les sanctions et les restrictions commerciales.

• Assurer la conformité à toutes les exigences réglementaires et politiques internes pertinentes. Diriger tous les aspects de l'établissement et du maintien de solides processus de gestion des risques contractuels.

Compétences requises

• Minimum de 10 ans d'expérience en tant que trader ou gestionnaire de risques dans les produits pétroliers physiques dans une maison de commerce de marchandises physiques de bonne réputation.

• Connaissance approfondie des marchés du pétrole, y compris les types de produits pétroliers, les mécanismes de tarification, la logistique, la qualité, le mélange et la dynamique du marché.

• Une bonne compréhension des conditions contractuelles, du risque de crédit et des participants du marché pétrolier en amont et en aval.

• Expérience éprouvée dans l'agrégation de l'exposition, la gestion des risques concentrés et les rapports à la haute direction.

• Compétence en SQL et Python, et autres outils pertinents pour la gestion des risques et le développement du système.

• Une bonne connaissance des produits financiers dérivés est indispensable.

• Excellentes compétences en communication avec les équipes de front et la haute direction.

• De solides compétences analytiques avec la capacité de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des scénarios de risque complexes et des tests de stress.

• Très motivé par un état d'esprit collaboratif et un vif appétit pour l'amélioration du système et l'innovation en gestion des risques.

Titres préférés

• Expérience dans l'élaboration et l'amélioration de systèmes de gestion des risques dans un environnement commercial.

• Familiarité avec le modèle d'affaires et l'approche de gestion des risques de Trafigura.

Attributs du succès

• Capacité de transverser les données sur les risques et de les traduire en une gestion des risques réalisable dans la pratique

• Travail confortable sur un large éventail d'articles tout en étant capable de se concentrer sur des sujets spécifiques au besoin

• Efficace pour parvenir à un consensus sur les initiatives de changement visant à favoriser l'avenir des entreprises

Aperçu du Département

L'équipe de gestion des risques du marché de Trafigura est responsable non seulement de l'identification et de la quantification des risques du marché pour les produits pétroliers, l'électricité et le gaz et les métaux, mais aussi de la gestion efficace des risques de ces expositions.

Egalité des chances employeur

Nous sommes un employeur de l'égalité des chances et nous sommes fiers d'un effectif diversifié! Nous ne faisons aucune discrimination en matière de recrutement, d'embauche, de formation, de promotion ou d'autres pratiques d'emploi pour des raisons de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'origine nationale, d'âge, de statut matrimonial ou vétéran, de condition médicale ou de handicap, d'invalidité ou de tout autre statut protégé par la loi.

jobs.title: CTRM Business Architect
jobs.description:
Main purpose
We are seeking a hands-on business architect to lead the front to back functional architecture for our Metals, Minerals & Bulk CTRM system. You will be transforming complex, cross-department business initiatives into architectural roadmaps, ensuring alignment of IT solutions with business objectives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Key responsibilities

• Transform business objectives into a functional architecture view that aligns IT and business teams

• Lead strategic architectural decisions, including buy vs. build recommendations

• Create actionable roadmaps balancing long-term vision with immediate needs

• Proficient in managing cross functional complexity and facilitating complex trade-off decisions, such as balancing global process standards with local market needs

• Support application teams throughout delivery, managing architectural alignment and accommodating change

• Guide the evolution of Trafigura’s functional landscape and conceptual data models

• Partner with technical leads to ensure our technical architecture supports business goals

• Keep up with industry trends to drive innovation and process improvements

• Lead and develop a team of architects, balancing their personal growth with business goals

• Foster a culture of collaboration and excellence across the IT organisation

Required qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in a business analyst and/or architect role

• 3+ years of experience managing and developing people within a fast-paced, high-performance environment

• Strong domain knowledge in commodity trading covering the end to end physical trade lifecycle

• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, frameworks, and modern practices like modular architecture and API-led integration

• Proven success delivering large-scale applications in global teams

• The ability to translate business goals into actionable technical plans, resolve complex conflicts, and make decisions that balance short-term needs with long-term vision

• Ability to plan and execute work independently with a proactive approach

• Comfortable working in a flat, matrix management structure

• Fluent in English

Preferred qualifications

jobs.description:
Main Purpose
The Senior Investigations Officer will report to the Global Head of Investigations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in forensic accounting, investigations, and risk management. The successful individual will work closely with a wide range of departments to identify and investigate Code of Conduct non-compliance and serious misconduct related risks in order to ensure the integrity and security of the organization’s operations. The investigations officer will also work closely with the Operational Risk and Internal Controls team (“ORIC”) to remediate investigation findings and strengthen the control environment.

The remit of the role will include, but not be limited to:

• Driving excellence - Supporting the Head of Investigations in driving forward an internal investigations team that seeks continued respect and trust from the business, and that is renowned for its professional, timely, proportionate and independent work.

• Investigation leadership - The oversight and management of substantial / reputationally significant internal investigations across the global business.

• Leadership - Acting as technical Subject Matter Expert and line manager to the existing Investigations Officers

• Cross-function collaboration and coordination - Supporting the Head of Investigations / ORIC to create a more connected and collaborative wider team whose combined remit is the design and testing of Internal controls, providing support to the business to strengthen the process and control environment, and to investigate and remediate control, policy and code of conduct breaches.

• Methodology development - Supporting in the creation and roll-out of robust and consistent investigation and review methodologies, tools and deliverables across the Group.

• Upskilling in the field of investigations - Developing and providing technical training across the business.

• Governance support - Providing ad hoc input on initiatives owned by the Risk and Compliance teams that intersect with Fraud / investigations.

• Issue remediation and anti-fraud framework development - Working with Internal Controls to develop enhanced, dedicated, controls to prevent and detect internal and external fraud; and working with Internal Audit to help establish audit prioritisation based upon the outcome and learnings from investigations.

Key responsibilities

• To support the Trafigura Global Head of Investigations in addressing the main objectives of the Investigation team (and potentially also across Operational Risk and Internal Control), now and into the future as the objectives and priorities evolve.

• Under the direction of the Head of Investigations, lead / conduct complex investigations into suspected cases of internal and / or external fraud, financial misconduct, policy non-compliance and other serious cases of misconduct in the context of the Code of Conduct.

• Interview witnesses and investigation subjects; gather statements, and document findings comprehensively.

• Prepare/draft detailed investigative reports, including findings, conclusions, and recommendations for review by senior stakeholders within the business. Present investigation results to compliance, senior management and legal counsel as required.

• Maintain thorough and accurate records of all investigations and related activities.

• Support the Head of Investigations and ORIC in prioritizing team resource, in supervising ongoing activity and in preparing for reporting required at Board sub-committees and the quarterly Governance and Controls Steering Committee.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of a risk-based country / market review strategy with supporting investigation plans.

• Contribute to the design and implementation of anti-fraud strategies, policies, and procedures. Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend control improvements.

• Utilize data analytics and forensic tools to detect anomalies and potential fraud indicators.

• Work closely with internal departments, including Legal, HR, IT, and Finance, to support investigations and implement corrective actions.

• Stay updated with industry best practices, regulatory changes, and emerging threats in fraud and financial crime.

Required qualifications

• Minimum 15 years of experience in performing corporate investigations, anti-fraud assessments or similar roles.

• Expert knowledge of investigative methodologies, forensic accounting principles, fraud detection techniques.

• Experience of leading overseas Ethics & Compliance or fraud-related fieldwork assignments (proactive or reactive), from planning to reporting, including management of team members, key stakeholders and the management of the target entity.

• Ability to demonstrate a track record of report writing, presenting to senior management / C-suite level.

• Experience of leading investigations across a range of fields – Financial, Operational, HR, HSE, Compliance & Ethics.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple investigations simultaneously. Demonstration of ability to project manage multiple projects in a high-pressure environment. Demonstrably ability to work collaboratively.

• Proficiency in using forensic tools and software for data analysis.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to integrity and confidentiality.

• Understanding of the mining, shipping, and commodity trading industries.

• Familiarity with financial regulations and compliance standards.

• Advanced experience and knowledge of current digital forensics and investigation techniques.

• Excellent English; native or equivalent to C2 level oral and written skills.

Preferred qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Criminal Justice, or a related field. Advanced degree or certifications (e.g., CFE, CPA, CIA) preferred.

Attributes for sucess

• Personal gravitas to operate comfortably and confidently with Senior Management of the business. Ability to build a network of key contacts within the business, across different offices. Firm, decisive and results oriented.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, demanding work environment, with strong work ethic and ability to meet deadlines.

• Ability and willingness to travel to meet project demands (anticipated travel expectation is less than 10%).

• Conversant in multiple languages relevant to Trafigura business considered a plus (Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese).

Department overview
As part of a wider investment and strengthening in the areas of Governance, Risk and Controls, Internal Audit and Compliance, in January 2025 the Chief Risk Officer and Global Head of Compliance established a new internal Investigations Team.

The Investigations team, currently a team of four based across Geneva and Athens, works alongside existing functions that support the Governance framework, with a remit to: lead the more sensitive and significant internal investigations; to support Legal in their response to regulatory enquiries; to coordinate and supervise investigations performed by the HR, Compliance or HSE teams; and, to oversee the Trafigura Speak Up channel.

The team is a fact-finding function focused on alleged misconduct by internal or external parties that impact Trafigura’s operations, assets, people or systems. The reactive work undertaken by the team is case-driven, event-specific, independent and confidential, and will often be defensive in nature, to minimise legal or reputational risk.

In addition to its ‘reactive’ work, and in coordination with the Operational Risk team, the Investigations team is tasked with performing forensic reviews of higher-risk markets and activities.

The team reports to the General Counsel and has a dotted line into the CEO and Audit Committee Chair. The team works closely with Trafigura’s Compliance, Internal Audit, Operational Risk and Internal Controls, Security, HR and CHESS teams as part of the wider network of functions charged with protecting the financial and reputational integrity of the company.

Panoramica del Dipartimento

Il team di Investigations, attualmente un team di quattro con sede a Ginevra e Atene, collabora con le funzioni esistenti che sostengono il quadro di Governance, con il compito di: guidare le indagini interne più sensibili e significative; sostenere Legale nella loro risposta alle indagini regolamentari; coordinare e supervisionare le indagini svolte dai team HR, Compliance o HSE; e, supervisionare il canale Trafigura Speak Up.

Oltre al suo lavoro “reattivo”, e in coordinamento con il team Operativo Risk, il team Investigations è incaricato di eseguire recensioni forensi su mercati e attività a rischio più elevato.

Il team riferisce al Consiglio Generale e ha una linea tratteggiata nel CEO e Audit Committee Chair. Main Purpose
The Senior Investigations Officer will report to the Global Head of Investigations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in forensic accounting, investigations, and risk management. The successful individual will work closely with a wide range of departments to identify and investigate Code of Conduct non-compliance and serious misconduct related risks in order to ensure the integrity and security of the organization’s operations. The investigations officer will also work closely with the Operational Risk and Internal Controls team (“ORIC”) to remediate investigation findings and strengthen the control environment.

The remit of the role will include, but not be limited to:

• Driving excellence - Supporting the Head of Investigations in driving forward an internal investigations team that seeks continued respect and trust from the business, and that is renowned for its professional, timely, proportionate and independent work.

• Investigation leadership - The oversight and management of substantial / reputationally significant internal investigations across the global business.

• Leadership - Acting as technical Subject Matter Expert and line manager to the existing Investigations Officers

• Cross-function collaboration and coordination - Supporting the Head of Investigations / ORIC to create a more connected and collaborative wider team whose combined remit is the design and testing of Internal controls, providing support to the business to strengthen the process and control environment, and to investigate and remediate control, policy and code of conduct breaches.

• Methodology development - Supporting in the creation and roll-out of robust and consistent investigation and review methodologies, tools and deliverables across the Group.

• Upskilling in the field of investigations - Developing and providing technical training across the business.

• Governance support - Providing ad hoc input on initiatives owned by the Risk and Compliance teams that intersect with Fraud / investigations.

• Issue remediation and anti-fraud framework development - Working with Internal Controls to develop enhanced, dedicated, controls to prevent and detect internal and external fraud; and working with Internal Audit to help establish audit prioritisation based upon the outcome and learnings from investigations.

Key responsibilities

• To support the Trafigura Global Head of Investigations in addressing the main objectives of the Investigation team (and potentially also across Operational Risk and Internal Control), now and into the future as the objectives and priorities evolve.

• Under the direction of the Head of Investigations, lead / conduct complex investigations into suspected cases of internal and / or external fraud, financial misconduct, policy non-compliance and other serious cases of misconduct in the context of the Code of Conduct.

• Interview witnesses and investigation subjects; gather statements, and document findings comprehensively.

• Prepare/draft detailed investigative reports, including findings, conclusions, and recommendations for review by senior stakeholders within the business. Present investigation results to compliance, senior management and legal counsel as required.

• Maintain thorough and accurate records of all investigations and related activities.

• Support the Head of Investigations and ORIC in prioritizing team resource, in supervising ongoing activity and in preparing for reporting required at Board sub-committees and the quarterly Governance and Controls Steering Committee.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of a risk-based country / market review strategy with supporting investigation plans.

• Contribute to the design and implementation of anti-fraud strategies, policies, and procedures. Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend control improvements.

• Utilize data analytics and forensic tools to detect anomalies and potential fraud indicators.

• Work closely with internal departments, including Legal, HR, IT, and Finance, to support investigations and implement corrective actions.

• Stay updated with industry best practices, regulatory changes, and emerging threats in fraud and financial crime.

Required qualifications

• Minimum 15 years of experience in performing corporate investigations, anti-fraud assessments or similar roles.

• Expert knowledge of investigative methodologies, forensic accounting principles, fraud detection techniques.

• Experience of leading overseas Ethics & Compliance or fraud-related fieldwork assignments (proactive or reactive), from planning to reporting, including management of team members, key stakeholders and the management of the target entity.

• Ability to demonstrate a track record of report writing, presenting to senior management / C-suite level.

• Experience of leading investigations across a range of fields – Financial, Operational, HR, HSE, Compliance & Ethics.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple investigations simultaneously. Demonstration of ability to project manage multiple projects in a high-pressure environment. Demonstrably ability to work collaboratively.

• Proficiency in using forensic tools and software for data analysis.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to integrity and confidentiality.

• Understanding of the mining, shipping, and commodity trading industries.

• Familiarity with financial regulations and compliance standards.

• Advanced experience and knowledge of current digital forensics and investigation techniques.

• Excellent English; native or equivalent to C2 level oral and written skills.

Preferred qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Criminal Justice, or a related field. Advanced degree or certifications (e.g., CFE, CPA, CIA) preferred.

Attributes for sucess

• Personal gravitas to operate comfortably and confidently with Senior Management of the business. Ability to build a network of key contacts within the business, across different offices. Firm, decisive and results oriented.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, demanding work environment, with strong work ethic and ability to meet deadlines.

• Ability and willingness to travel to meet project demands (anticipated travel expectation is less than 10%).

• Conversant in multiple languages relevant to Trafigura business considered a plus (Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese).

Department overview
As part of a wider investment and strengthening in the areas of Governance, Risk and Controls, Internal Audit and Compliance, in January 2025 the Chief Risk Officer and Global Head of Compliance established a new internal Investigations Team.

The Investigations team, currently a team of four based across Geneva and Athens, works alongside existing functions that support the Governance framework, with a remit to: lead the more sensitive and significant internal investigations; to support Legal in their response to regulatory enquiries; to coordinate and supervise investigations performed by the HR, Compliance or HSE teams; and, to oversee the Trafigura Speak Up channel.

The team is a fact-finding function focused on alleged misconduct by internal or external parties that impact Trafigura’s operations, assets, people or systems. The reactive work undertaken by the team is case-driven, event-specific, independent and confidential, and will often be defensive in nature, to minimise legal or reputational risk.

In addition to its ‘reactive’ work, and in coordination with the Operational Risk team, the Investigations team is tasked with performing forensic reviews of higher-risk markets and activities.

The team reports to the General Counsel and has a dotted line into the CEO and Audit Committee Chair. The team works closely with Trafigura’s Compliance, Internal Audit, Operational Risk and Internal Controls, Security, HR and CHESS teams as part of the wider network of functions charged with protecting the financial and reputational integrity of the company.

Equal opportunity employer
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse workforce! We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Hauptzweck
Der Senior Investigations Officer wird an den Global Head of Investigations berichten. Der ideale Kandidat wird einen starken Hintergrund in forensischer Buchhaltung, Untersuchungen und Risikomanagement haben. Die erfolgreiche Person wird eng mit einer Vielzahl von Abteilungen zusammenarbeiten, um die Nichteinhaltung von Verhaltensregeln und schwerwiegende Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Fehlverhalten zu identifizieren und zu untersuchen, um die Integrität und Sicherheit der Geschäftstätigkeit der Organisation zu gewährleisten. Der Untersuchungsbeauftragte wird auch eng mit dem Team für operationelle Risiken und interne Kontrollen („ORIC) zusammenarbeiten, um Untersuchungsergebnisse zu beheben und die Kontrollumgebung zu stärken.

Der Aufgabenbereich der Rolle umfasst unter anderem:

• Driving Excellence - Unterstützung des Ermittlungsleiters bei der Förderung eines internen Untersuchungsteams, das weiterhin Respekt und Vertrauen vom Unternehmen sucht und für seine professionelle, zeitnahe, verhältnismäßige und unabhängige Arbeit bekannt ist.

• Ermittlungsführung - Die Aufsicht und Verwaltung von erheblichen / reputationsrelevanten internen Untersuchungen im globalen Geschäft.

• Führung - Als technischer Subject Matter Expert und Line Manager für die bestehenden Investigations Officers fungieren

• Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und Koordination - Unterstützung des Untersuchungsleiters / ORIC bei der Schaffung eines stärker vernetzten und kollaborativen breiteren Teams, dessen kombinierter Aufgabenbereich die Gestaltung und Erprobung interner Kontrollen ist, die Unterstützung des Unternehmens bei der Stärkung der Prozess- und Kontrollumgebung sowie bei der Untersuchung und Behebung von Verstößen gegen Kontrollen, Richtlinien und Verhaltenskodizes.

• Methodikentwicklung - Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Einführung robuster und konsistenter Untersuchungs- und Überprüfungsmethoden, -werkzeuge und -ergebnisse im gesamten Konzern.

• Upskilling im Bereich der Untersuchungen - Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von technischen Schulungen im gesamten Unternehmen.

• Governance-Unterstützung - Bereitstellung von Ad-hoc-Input zu Initiativen der Risiko- und Compliance-Teams, die sich mit Betrug / Untersuchungen überschneiden.

• Entwicklung von Rahmenbedingungen für Problembehebung und Betrugsbekämpfung - Arbeiten mit internen Kontrollen zur Entwicklung verbesserter, dedizierter Kontrollen zur Verhinderung und Aufdeckung interner und externer Betrugsfälle; und Arbeiten mit interner Revision, um die Priorisierung von Audits basierend auf den Ergebnissen und Erkenntnissen aus Untersuchungen zu unterstützen.

Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten

• Interviewen Sie Zeugen und Untersuchungsteilnehmer; sammeln Sie Aussagen und dokumentieren Sie die Ergebnisse umfassend.

• Bereiten Sie detaillierte Untersuchungsberichte vor, einschließlich Ergebnisse, Schlussfolgerungen und Empfehlungen für die Überprüfung durch leitende Stakeholder im Unternehmen. Aktuelle Untersuchungsergebnisse zu Compliance, Senior Management und Rechtsberatung nach Bedarf.

• Führen Sie gründliche und genaue Aufzeichnungen über alle Untersuchungen und damit verbundenen Aktivitäten.

• Unterstützung des Untersuchungsleiters und des ORIC bei der Priorisierung der Teamressourcen, bei der Überwachung der laufenden Aktivitäten und bei der Vorbereitung der in den Board-Unterausschüssen und dem vierteljährlichen Governance and Controls Steering Committee erforderlichen Berichterstattung.

• Beitrag zur Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Strategien, Strategien und Verfahren zur Betrugsbekämpfung. Führen Sie Betrugsrisikobewertungen durch und empfehlen Sie Kontrollverbesserungen.

Erforderliche Qualifikationen

• Erfahrung in führenden Untersuchungen in einer Reihe von Bereichen - Finanzen, Betrieb, HR, HSE, Compliance & Ethik.

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und mehrere Untersuchungen gleichzeitig zu verwalten. Demonstration der Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte in einer Hochdruckumgebung zu verwalten. Nachweislich Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit.

• Kenntnisse im Einsatz forensischer Tools und Software für die Datenanalyse.

• Hohe ethische Standards und ein Bekenntnis zu Integrität und Vertraulichkeit.

• Verständnis der Bergbau-, Schifffahrts- und Rohstoffhandelsbranche.

• Vertrautheit mit Finanzvorschriften und Compliance-Standards.

• Fortgeschrittene Erfahrung und Kenntnisse der aktuellen digitalen Forensik und Untersuchungstechniken.

• Hervorragendes Englisch; native oder gleichwertig zu C2 Niveau mündliche und schriftliche Fähigkeiten.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

• Starke schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen klar und prägnant zu präsentieren.

• Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen, anspruchsvollen Arbeitsumfeld mit starker Arbeitsmoral und der Fähigkeit, Termine einzuhalten, zu gedeihen.

• Fähigkeit und Reisebereitschaft, um die Projektanforderungen zu erfüllen (voraussichtliche Reiseerwartungen sind weniger als 10%).

• Konversant in mehreren Sprachen, die für das Trafigura-Geschäft relevant sind, wird als Plus angesehen (Spanisch, Französisch, Portugiesisch, Chinesisch).

Abteilungsübersicht
Im Rahmen einer breiteren Investition und Stärkung in den Bereichen Governance, Risk and Controls, Internal Audit und Compliance hat der Chief Risk Officer und Global Head of Compliance im Januar 2025 ein neues internes Investigationsteam eingerichtet.

Das Investigations-Team, derzeit ein vierköpfiges Team mit Sitz in Genf und Athen, arbeitet neben bestehenden Funktionen, die das Governance-Framework unterstützen, mit dem Auftrag, die sensibleren und bedeutenderen internen Untersuchungen zu leiten, Legal bei der Reaktion auf regulatorische Anfragen zu unterstützen, die von den HR-, Compliance- oder HSE-Teams durchgeführten Untersuchungen zu koordinieren und zu überwachen und den Trafigura Speak Up-Kanal zu beaufsichtigen.

Das Team ist eine Fact-Finding-Funktion, die sich auf angebliches Fehlverhalten von internen oder externen Parteien konzentriert, die sich auf die Operationen, Vermögenswerte, Personen oder Systeme von Trafigura auswirken. Die reaktive Arbeit des Teams ist fallorientiert, ereignisspezifisch, unabhängig und vertraulich und wird oft defensiver Natur sein, um rechtliche oder Reputationsrisiken zu minimieren.

Zusätzlich zu seiner "reaktiven" Arbeit und in Abstimmung mit dem Operational Risk Team ist das Investigations Team mit der Durchführung forensischer Überprüfungen von Märkten und Aktivitäten mit höherem Risiko beauftragt.

Das Team berichtet an den General Counsel und hat eine gestrichelte Linie in den CEO und Audit Committee Chair. Das Team arbeitet eng mit den Teams von Trafigura in den Bereichen Compliance, Interne Revision, Betriebsrisiko und Interne Kontrollen, Sicherheit, Personal und CHESS als Teil des breiteren Netzwerks von Funktionen zusammen, die mit dem Schutz der finanziellen und reputativen Integrität des Unternehmens betraut sind.

Objet principal
L'agent principal chargé des enquêtes relèvera du chef mondial des enquêtes. Le candidat idéal aura une solide expérience en comptabilité judiciaire, en enquêtes et en gestion des risques. La personne qui réussit travaillera en étroite collaboration avec un large éventail de ministères afin de déterminer et d'enquêter sur la non-conformité au Code de conduite et les risques graves liés à l'inconduite afin d'assurer l'intégrité et la sécurité des opérations de l'organisation. L'agent d'enquête travaillera également en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe des risques opérationnels et des contrôles internes (ORIC) pour corriger les conclusions des enquêtes et renforcer l'environnement de contrôle.

La mission du rôle consistera notamment à :

• L'excellence en matière de conduite - Aider le chef des enquêtes à faire avancer une équipe d'enquêtes internes qui recherche le respect et la confiance continus de l'entreprise et qui est réputée pour son travail professionnel, opportun, proportionné et indépendant.

• Leadership des enquêtes - La surveillance et la gestion des enquêtes internes importantes et importantes sur le plan de la réputation dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise mondiale.

• Leadership - À titre d'expert technique et de gestionnaire hiérarchique auprès des agents d'enquête existants

• Collaboration et coordination interfonctionnelles - Aider le chef des enquêtes / ORIC à créer une équipe plus large, plus connectée et collaborative dont la mission combinée est la conception et l'essai des contrôles internes, fournir un soutien à l'entreprise pour renforcer l'environnement de processus et de contrôle, et enquêter et réparer les manquements au contrôle, à la politique et au code de conduite.

• Élaboration de méthodes - Appuyer la création et la mise en oeuvre de méthodes, d'outils et de produits d'enquête et d'examen robustes et cohérents dans l'ensemble du Groupe.

• Améliorer les compétences dans le domaine des enquêtes - Développer et fournir une formation technique dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

• Soutien à la gouvernance - Fournir des commentaires spéciaux sur les initiatives détenues par les équipes de risque et de conformité qui se croisent avec la fraude et les enquêtes.

• Mise en place d'un cadre de remédiation et de lutte contre la fraude - Collaborer avec les contrôles internes à l'élaboration de contrôles renforcés, dédiés, pour prévenir et détecter la fraude interne et externe; et collaborer avec l'Audit interne pour aider à établir des priorités d'audit en fonction des résultats et des enseignements tirés des enquêtes.

Principales responsabilités

• Aider Trafigura Global Head of Investigations à atteindre les principaux objectifs de l'équipe d'enquête (ainsi que les risques opérationnels et le contrôle interne), maintenant et à l'avenir, à mesure que les objectifs et les priorités évoluent.

• Sous la direction du chef des enquêtes, diriger ou mener des enquêtes complexes sur des cas présumés de fraude interne et/ou externe, d'inconduite financière, de non-respect des politiques et d'autres cas graves d'inconduite dans le contexte du Code de conduite.

• Interroger les témoins et les sujets d'enquête; recueillir des déclarations et documenter les conclusions de façon exhaustive.

• Préparer ou rédiger des rapports d'enquête détaillés, y compris des constatations, des conclusions et des recommandations, qui seront examinés par les principaux intervenants de l'entreprise. Présenter les résultats de l'enquête à la conformité, à la haute direction et aux avocats, au besoin.

• Tenir des registres complets et exacts de toutes les enquêtes et activités connexes.

• Aider le chef des enquêtes et l'ORIC à prioriser les ressources de l'équipe, à superviser les activités en cours et à préparer les rapports requis aux sous-comités du Conseil et au comité directeur trimestriel de la gouvernance et des contrôles.

• Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie d'examen des pays et des marchés axée sur les risques, assortie de plans d'enquête.

• Contribuer à la conception et à la mise en oeuvre de stratégies, de politiques et de procédures antifraude. Effectuer des évaluations des risques de fraude et recommander des améliorations au contrôle.

• Utiliser des outils d'analyse de données et de criminalistique pour détecter les anomalies et les indicateurs de fraude potentiels.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les ministères internes, y compris les services juridiques, les RH, les TI et les Finances, pour appuyer les enquêtes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives.

• Restez informé des pratiques exemplaires de l'industrie, des changements réglementaires et des nouvelles menaces liées à la fraude et à la criminalité financière.

Compétences requises

• Au moins 15 ans d'expérience dans l'exécution d'enquêtes, d'évaluations antifraude ou de rôles semblables.

• Connaissance des méthodes d'enquête, des principes de comptabilité légale, des techniques de détection de la fraude.

jobs.title: Trade Finance, Automation Lead
jobs.description:
Main purpose
Trafigura is seeking a senior Automation Lead to join its Trade Finance function. This is a strategic, dual-profile appointment whose primary mandate is to accelerate the team’s adoption of AI, automation, and modern tooling – while maintaining operational credibility on the desk to understand workflows from the inside and drive meaningful, sustained change.

The successful candidate will act as the bridge between Trade Finance operations and IT delivery teams, translating business friction into prioritised, deliverable automation initiatives. This role requires a demonstrable track record as a change agent, combined with sound Trade Finance domain knowledge.

Key responsibilities
Technology & Automation Leadership

• Own and maintain the Trade Finance technology and automation roadmap – identifying, prioritizing, and driving high-ROI use cases across reporting, reconciliation, controls, credit workflows, and document handling.

• Own digitalization and technology projects related to Trade Finance end-to-end – from scoping, business case, and vendor/platform evaluation through to delivery, rollout, and adoption.

• Build robust business cases for each initiative, aligned with IT architecture guidelines and the function’s future-state vision.

• Partner with IT delivery teams to progress priority initiatives from concept through to production deployment, remaining engaged at every stage.

• Map and redesign business processes ahead of automation, ensuring workflows are optimized before tooling is applied.

• Prototype solutions or produce precise, IT-consumable business requirements to validate value and support production build decisions.

• Develop reusable artefacts – templates, playbooks, and requirement patterns – that accelerate future automation initiatives.

• Coach and upskill Trade Finance colleagues in modern, tool-driven ways of working, including prompt design, tool adoption, and process instrumentation.

• Serve as the visible technology advocate for the team, sharing practical outcomes and embedding a data-led, digitally native culture.

• Monitor external benchmarks from peer trading houses and Trade Finance technology providers (e.g. Komgo, Contour, Traydstream, Enigio, Bolero) and assess their applicability internally.

• Represent Trade Finance in cross-functional technology transformation forums.

• Ensure new tools and products are adopted effectively by business domains, with value measurement frameworks in place.
Trade Finance Operations

• Execute day-to-day Trade Finance responsibilities across the full instrument lifecycle, including:
• Letters of Credit: Drafting, reviewing, and ensuring compliance against UCP 600 terms; liaising with issuing banks and counterparties to satisfy collateral requirements.

• Receivable Discounting: Managing eligible receivables pools, coordinating with financing banks, and tracking utilization against approved limits.

• Borrowing Base Reporting: Compiling eligible assets and liabilities, applying advance rates and concentration limits, and preparing periodic certificates for submission to lending banks.

• Contribute to credit-limit management, collateral monitoring, and controls – flagging exceptions, escalating exposures, and ensuring bank reporting is accurate and delivered on time.

• Support Trade Finance officers during peak volume periods, audits, and monthly reporting cycles.

• Serve as an operational subject-matter expert whose hands-on experience directly informs automation priorities – identifying manual touchpoints, data gaps, and process inefficiencies that represent the highest-value opportunities on the roadmap.

Required qualifications
Experience

• Minimum 7+ years of experience combining Trade Finance or commodity finance operations with technology-driven transformation.

• Prior experience at a commodity trading house’s Trade Finance or finance function with a demonstrable transformation track record, or at a Trade Finance fintech (e.g. Komgo, Contour, Traydstream, Enigio, Bolero, TradeSun, or equivalent).

• Documented automation or AI projects personally led or co-led, with quantified outcomes – including hours saved, error rate reductions, or cycle time improvements.

• Background in technology-driven business transformation: business analyst, project or programme manager, super user, or product/scrum lead.

• Experience working with leading-edge technology platforms in the Trade Finance domain.
Technical skills

• Working knowledge of SQL; proficiency in Python or a low-code/no-code platform (e.g. Power Apps, Retool, Alteryx, UiPath, n8n).

• Familiarity with the broader enterprise and modern AI tooling landscape (document intelligence/OCR, agent orchestration, LLM deployment models, AI agents) beyond Trade Finance-specific platforms.

• Ability to specify integrations between trade systems (ETRM / TMS / GL / bank platforms) – integration build expertise is not required, but the ability to scope, brief, and challenge IT credibly is essential.

• Ability to interpret system architecture diagrams and data models independently.

• Comfortable prototyping with AI tools, with genuine curiosity about the application of data and AI to business processes.

• Ability to produce precise, IT-consumable requirements specifications.
Domain knowledge

• Sound understanding of Trade Finance instruments and workflows: open account, Letters of Credit, borrowing base reporting, credit exposure, collateral management, and receivable discounting.

• Familiarity with commodity trading flows (e.g. pipeline, storage, blending, in-transit financing) is advantageous.

Preferred qualifications

• Prior experience with next-generation ETRM platforms (e.g. Atlas, Titan).

• Familiarity with AI risk/governance frameworks.

• Experience designing evaluation/quality-control mechanisms for AI-generated outputs, particularly where outputs feed into external reporting.

• Background in consulting (Big 4 or MBB) with a Trade Finance or commodities focus.

• Dual language (English and French or Spanish).

Attributes for success

• A genuine change agent: creative, driven, and collaborative, with a strong bias towards outcomes.

• Practical prompt engineering experience: demonstrable ability to design, test, and iterate prompts for reliability.

• Comfortable challenging existing processes and incumbents, with the patience to bring stakeholders along and the resilience to manage pushback.

• Hands-on by instinct – focused on making things work rather than directing from a distance.

• Able to navigate ambiguity and make progress without a fully defined brief.

• Effective in cross-functional (business and IT) teams delivering complex products or projects.

• Actively models and builds a data- and AI-led culture across the wider team.

• A collaborative team player with a commitment to continuous learning.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Obiettivo principale
Trafigura sta cercando un senior Automation Lead per aderire alla sua funzione Trade Finance. Si tratta di un appuntamento strategico e dual-profile il cui mandato primario è quello di accelerare l’adozione del team di AI, automazione e strumenti moderni – mantenendo la credibilità operativa sulla scrivania per capire i flussi di lavoro dall’interno e guidare cambiamenti significativi e sostenuti.

Il candidato di successo fungerà da ponte tra le operazioni di Trade Finance e i team di distribuzione IT, traducendo l'attrito di business in iniziative di automazione prioritarie e consegnabili. Questo ruolo richiede un record di traccia dimostrabile come agente di cambiamento, combinato con la conoscenza del dominio Trade Finance.

Responsabilità chiave
Leadership tecnologica e automazione

• Proprie e mantengono la roadmap della tecnologia Trade Finance e dell'automazione – identificando, dando priorità e guidando casi di utilizzo ad alto livello di ROI attraverso reportistica, riconciliazione, controlli, flussi di lavoro di credito e gestione dei documenti.

• Progetti di digitalizzazione e tecnologia propri relativi a Trade Finance end-to-end – da scoping, business case, e la valutazione vendor/platform fino alla consegna, rollout e adozione.

• Costruire robusti casi di business per ogni iniziativa, allineati con le linee guida di architettura IT e la visione futura-stato della funzione.

• Partner con i team di distribuzione IT per promuovere iniziative prioritarie dal concept fino alla distribuzione della produzione, rimanendo impegnati in ogni fase.

• Mappa e riprogettare i processi aziendali prima dell'automazione, assicurando che i flussi di lavoro siano ottimizzati prima dell'applicazione degli utensili.

• Soluzioni prototipi o producono requisiti aziendali precisi e di consumo IT per convalidare le decisioni di produzione di valore e supporto.

• Sviluppa artefatti riutilizzabili – modelli, playbook e modelli di requisiti – che accelerano le future iniziative di automazione.

• Coach e upskill Trade Finance colleghi in modi moderni e guidati dagli strumenti di lavoro, tra cui la progettazione rapida, l'adozione degli strumenti e la strumentazione di processo.

• Servire come sostenitore della tecnologia visibile per il team, la condivisione dei risultati pratici e l'integrazione di una cultura data-led, digitalmente nativo.

• Monitorare i benchmark esterni delle case commerciali peer e dei fornitori di tecnologie Trade Finance (ad esempio Komgo, Contour, Traydstream, Enigio, Bolero) e valutare la loro applicabilità interna.

• Rappresentare Trade Finance in forum di trasformazione tecnologica interfunzionale.

• Assicurare nuovi strumenti e prodotti sono adottati in modo efficace da domini aziendali, con i framework di misurazione del valore in atto.
Operazioni di finanza commerciale

• Eseguire le responsabilità di Trade Finance di giorno per giorno in tutto il ciclo di vita dello strumento completo, tra cui:
• Lettere di Credito: redazione, revisione e conformità ai termini UCP 600; lione con le banche esecutive e le controparti per soddisfare i requisiti collaterali.

• Sconti: Gestione dei pool di crediti ammissibili, coordinamento con le banche di finanziamento e monitoraggio dell'utilizzo contro i limiti approvati.

• Resoconto di base: Compiling attività e passività ammissibili, l'applicazione di tassi di anticipo e limiti di concentrazione, e la preparazione di certificati periodici per la presentazione alle banche di prestito.

• Contribuire alla gestione dei limiti di credito, al monitoraggio collaterale e ai controlli – le eccezioni di segnalazione, l'aumento delle esposizioni, e garantire la segnalazione bancaria è accurata e consegnata in tempo.

• Supporta gli ufficiali di finanza commerciale durante i periodi di picco, gli audit e i cicli di report mensili.

• Serve come esperto di soggetti operativi la cui esperienza pratica informa direttamente le priorità di automazione – identificando touchpoint manuali, lacune di dati e inefficienze di processo che rappresentano le opportunità di maggior valore sulla roadmap.

qualifiche richieste
Esperienza

• Minimo 7+ anni di esperienza che combinano operazioni di finanza commerciale o finanza merci con trasformazione tecnologica-driven.

• Esperienza prioritaria nella funzione Trade Finance o Finance di una casa di commercio di materie prime con un record di binario di trasformazione dimostrabile, o in un Fintech Trade Finance (ad esempio Komgo, Contour, Traydstream, Enigio, Bolero, TradeSun, o equivalente).

• I progetti di automazione documentata o AI hanno condotto personalmente o co-led, con risultati quantificati – tra cui ore salvate, riduzioni dei tassi di errore, o miglioramenti del tempo di ciclo.

• Sfondo nella trasformazione aziendale basata sulla tecnologia: analista aziendale, responsabile del progetto o del programma, utente super, o prodotto/capo.

• Esperienza di lavoro con piattaforme tecnologiche all'avanguardia nel dominio Trade Finance.
Capacità tecniche

• Conoscenza di lavoro di SQL; competenza in Python o una piattaforma a basso codice/no-code (ad esempio Power Apps, Retool, Alteryx, UiPath, n8n).

• Familiarità con l'impresa più ampia e moderno AI tooling landscape (document intelligence/OCR, orchestrazione agente, modelli di distribuzione LLM, agenti AI) oltre Trade Finance-specific piattaforme.

• Possibilità di specificare le integrazioni tra sistemi commerciali (ETRM / TMS / GL / piattaforme bancarie) – l'esperienza di costruzione di integrazione non è necessaria, ma la capacità di portata, breve e sfida IT credibilmente è essenziale.

• Capacità di interpretare schemi di architettura del sistema e modelli di dati indipendentemente.

• Confortevole prototipazione con strumenti AI, con vera curiosità circa l'applicazione dei dati e AI ai processi aziendali.

• Capacità di produrre specifiche esigenze precise e di consumo IT.
Conoscenza del dominio

• Comprensione sonora degli strumenti e dei flussi di lavoro di Trade Finance: account aperto, Lettere di Credito, rendicontazione della base di prestito, esposizione del credito, gestione collaterale e riscossione.

• La familiarità con i flussi di scambio di merci (ad esempio conduttura, stoccaggio, miscelazione, finanziamento in-transit) è vantaggiosa.

Le qualifiche previste

• Esperienza prioritaria con piattaforme ETRM di nuova generazione (ad esempio Atlas, Titan).

• Familiarità con i quadri di rischio/governo AI.

• Esperienza nella progettazione di meccanismi di valutazione/controllo della qualità per le uscite generate dall'intelligenza artificiale, in particolare quando le uscite si nutrono di report esterni.

• Sfondo in consulenza (Big 4 o MBB) con un focus di Trade Finance o materie prime.

• Lingua doppia (inglese e francese o spagnolo).

Attributi per il successo

• Un vero e proprio agente di cambiamento: creativo, guidato e collaborativo, con un forte pregiudizio verso i risultati.

• Esperienza di ingegneria rapida pratica: capacità dimostrabile di progettare, testare e iterare richieste di affidabilità.

• Confortevole sfidare i processi esistenti e gli incumbents, con la pazienza di portare gli stakeholder insieme e la resilienza per gestire il pushback.

• Hands-on dall'istinto – focalizzato sul fare le cose funzionano piuttosto che dirigersi da una distanza.

• In grado di navigare ambiguità e fare progressi senza un breve completamente definito.

• Efficace nei team interfunzionali (business e IT) che offrono prodotti o progetti complessi.

• Modella attivamente e costruisce una cultura basata sui dati e sull'intelligenza artificiale in tutto il team.

• Un team player collaborativo con un impegno per l'apprendimento continuo.
